guide.tagline: Watch, browse and run your servers and containers from one place.
guide.summary: Add any computer you can reach over SSH. Edith shows its CPU, memory and disk, opens a terminal, browses files and manages Docker containers. Your Mac is already listed. Removing a machine only forgets it; nothing on the machine changes.

steps.title: Add a machine
steps.detail: Enter its address and username, or pick a host from your SSH config.

steps.title: Watch its health
steps.detail: See CPU, memory, disk and running containers for every machine at a glance.

steps.title: Open a terminal or files
steps.detail: Pick a machine to run commands, browse and transfer files, or manage Docker.

steps.title: Build a workspace
steps.detail: Arrange terminals from several machines side by side in split panes.
